task.title: Wire redacted business and notification count sources
task.input: Persisted inquiries/chat/ChatNotification and real request counters
task.output: stats-business and explicitly scoped notification/HTTP-error sources
task.accept: 1) Caller authorized business/mail/http sources in GET /api/admin/stats leads to read-only adapters; count by durable and immutable business identifiers, without increments for retries/rejected spam; results must contain no email/body, and saving business data must not wait for the dashboard (E-62). 2) Mail must reflect actual attempt/sent/failed states rather than queuing; HTTP must claim coverage only for actually instrumented routes, while unconnected sources show not_connected; a source failure must independently retain its old time or show an error when no old value exists (E-51, E-52, E-53, E-54, E-64, E-67).
